lines: Himanshu Kantilal Sanghavi HUF is an Investor Selling Shareholder in the offer for sale, selling up to 25,200 shares.
Proceeds are up to ₹3.41 crore if all offered shares are sold; the employee-portion discount means actual proceeds are slightly lower.
The gain is up to ₹2.52 crore before offer expenses and taxes, and the retained stake is an estimate of ₹7.95 crore at the offer price.

Timing: the money has been in hand since listing (trading started March 11, 2026), so the call is timely to discuss what they do next. Confidence is medium, as the holding appears in one section only.
